title: Vegan Quick Dishes Under 20 Minutes: Mug Cake, Tofu Ricotta Pizza, Grilled-Cheese-Style Melt, and Cinnamon Rolls
summary: This Goodful video presents a sequence of plant-based recipes designed to be ready in under 20 minutes, demonstrated through a mix of microwave, toaster oven, and quick-stovetop techniques. The host first builds a simple chocolate mug cake from dry and wet ingredients, microwaves it, and tops with vegan chips. Next, a fast tofu ricotta is blended and used to top a pita-based vegan pizza that’s finished under a broil. A separate microwave macaroni dish uses oat milk, nutritional yeast, and a vinegar blend to mimic cheese richness. The episode also covers a dairy-free cheese spread made from coconut oil and herbs to pair with toasted bread, plus a dramatic, high-speed microwave cinnamon roll with a simple icing. Throughout, the host emphasizes speed, beginner-friendliness, and customization with pantry staples.
topics: Dry ingredients for cake (brown sugar, flour, cocoa powder)
Wet ingredients for cake (vegetable oil, vanilla, salt)
Apple cider vinegar as acidity in vegan cheese
Rice wine vinegar as lactic acid substitute
Italian seasoning and fennel seeds on pizza
Herbs in vegan cheese (chives, dill, parsley)
Refined vs unrefined coconut oil in desserts
Microwave icing from powdered sugar and non-dairy milk

adding wet ingredients (vegetable oil, vanilla, salt)
microwave baking in a wide mug
melting vegan chocolate chips on top
sections.description: Dry and wet ingredients are mixed together and transferred to a wide mug, then microwaved for about 1.5–2 minutes. After baking, vegan chocolate chips are added to melt with the heat.

finishing blend until smooth
advancing prep for quick-use toppings
sections.description: Tofu ricotta is prepared by blending tofu with nutritional yeast, vinegar, salt, and garlic powder until smooth, enabling quick assembly for a subsequent vegan pizza.

marinara sauce spread
dollops of ricotta on top

adding oat milk, nutritional yeast, and rice wine vinegar to mimic cheese acidity and texture

sections.title: Dairy-Free Spread and Open-Faced Cheese Toast

folding in flour to form dough
toasted bread with cheese-like spread
sections.description: A dairy-free spread is created with refined coconut oil and flavorings, folded with applesauce and flour, then used to top toasted bread with a cheese-like finish.
